units.source_text: 七七期间，宇治山庄中人数众多，不甚感觉凄凉。

en.t: During the forty-nine-day mourning period, many people were at the Uji villa, so it did not feel especially desolate.

units.source_text: 只是二女公子深恐他人讥诮，甚感羞耻。

en.t: Only the Second Princess was deeply afraid of being mocked by others and felt terribly ashamed.

units.source_text: 痛念自身命苦，日夜悲伤，似乎也要去了。

en.t: Grieving bitterly over her own ill-fated life, she wept day and night and seemed as though she too might die.
Prince Niou repeatedly sent messengers to offer comfort and inquire after her.

units.source_text: 惟大女公子一向视此人为意想不到的薄情人，直到死去犹不能谅解，

en.t: But the Elder Princess had always regarded him as an unexpectedly heartless man, and even at her death she could not forgive him,

units.source_text: 故二女公子认为结识此人，是一段恶姻缘。

en.t: so the Second Princess thought that having come to know him was an ill-fated bond.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言想乘此忧愁苦恨的时机，成遂了出家之本愿。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, thought he might take this time of sorrow and anguish to fulfill his long-held wish to become a monk.

units.source_text: 然而深恐三条宫邸中的母亲伤心，又挂念二女公子孤苦无依，左思右想，心绪缭乱。

en.t: However, he deeply feared grieving his mother at the Sanjo residence, and he also worried that the Second Princess would be left lonely and without support; turning it over again and again, his thoughts were in turmoil.

units.source_text: 既而自忖：“还不如依照大女公子遗言，把这妹妹当作死者遗念而爱护她吧。

en.t: Before long he reflected: "It would be better to follow the Elder Princess's last words and cherish this younger sister as a keepsake of the dead.

units.source_text: 讲到我的本意，她虽然是大女公子的嫡亲妹妹，我也不肯把爱情移转到她身上。

en.t: As for my true intention, even though she is the Elder Princess's own sister, I could not transfer my love to her.

units.source_text: 但与其让她孤苦伶仃，不如把她当作纯洁的话伴，常常来此相晤，亦可稍慰我对亡人永无尽期的恋慕。”

en.t: But rather than leave her all alone, I could treat her as a pure companion in conversation and come here often to meet her; that might somewhat soothe my endless longing for the one who is gone."

units.source_text: 他绝不返京，与世隔绝，只管忧愁苦恨地笼闭在山中。

en.t: He absolutely refused to return to the capital; cut off from the world, he shut himself away in the mountains, sunk only in sorrow and anguish.

units.source_text: 世人闻知情状，想见他对亡人恩情非浅，自宫中开始，各方来吊慰者甚多。

en.t: When people heard of the situation, they imagined his feeling for the deceased must be very deep, and many came from all quarters, beginning with the palace, to offer condolences and comfort.
